delete.title: Delete connection
delete.message: Delete "{name}"? The socket is closed and the connection disappears from the workspace. This cannot be undone.

liveNotice: The socket is still open: what you change here applies the next time it connects.

protocols.label: Subprotocols
protocols.description: Comma separated, in order of preference.

maxMessage.label: Maximum message size
maxMessage.description: A larger frame closes the connection instead of reserving memory for it.

verifyCertificate.label: Verify the server certificate
verifyCertificate.warning: Without verification any certificate is accepted, including one from a third party sitting in the middle: the traffic of this connection can be read and modified unnoticed. Use it only against a development server under your control.

hint.after: . A token belongs in a secret variable of the environment: written here it would be saved in the workspace file.

enabled.label: Reconnect when the server hangs up
enabled.hint: Does not affect a failed first attempt or a manual disconnection.

base.label: Initial wait
base.description: Doubles on every attempt until it reaches the maximum wait.

enabled.label: Send a periodic ping
enabled.hint: If the pong does not arrive within the timeout, the connection is taken as dropped.
